title: The aim
text: Two sides, each guarding a set of cups. Land the ball in the other side's cups. A cup that is hit is taken away. The first side to clear the other's cups wins.

title: Playing
text: Set the cups up at each end of the board in the shape the board shows. Sides take turns to throw or bounce the ball at the far cups. What a hit costs the other side, and whether a bounce counts double, is for your table to agree before the first throw.

title: Keeping count
text: I do not know your house rules and will not pretend to. Tap a name each time that side sinks a cup, and press the button to pass the turn.
